crossRefs.note: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be…
He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked…
One day Elisha went to Shunem, where there was a prominent woman; and she persuaded him to eat bread. So it was, that…
A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us. The Lord…

translations.web: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.
translations.bsb: But they pleaded with Him, “Stay with us, for it is nearly evening and the day is almost over.” So He went in to stay with them.
translations.kjv: But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them.
translations.asv: And they constrained him, saying, Abide with us; for it is toward evening, and the day is now far spent. And he went in to abide with them.
